description: Regenerated after the review 7B physics fixes, verified by hand: the pivot pressure now relieves buoyancy built up to the way end (F_b = 0.5 rho g Cb B t^2 sin(theta) = 20.63 MN, 52.6% of the weight at t = 70 m) and divides by the total way width only (the old value double-counted the way count); the slamming pressure uses the vertical entry velocity component v*sin(theta). Sliding velocity, full-contact pressure and launch draft are unchanged closed-form statics.
